title: Set up Mewvo in {server}
intro: What is set up in this server so far. Most settings are on the dashboard.
noDashboard: The dashboard link is not available on this bot yet.

modLog.label: Mod log channel
modLog.next: Pick a channel on the dashboard (Enforcement).

staff.label: Staff review channel
staff.next: Pick a channel on the dashboard (Automod).
staff.fallback: Not set: reviews go to the mod log. Pick a channel on the dashboard (Automod).

appeals.label: Appeals
appeals.mewvo: Members appeal in the Mewvo support server.
appeals.mewvoChoice: Members appeal in the Mewvo support server. You can use your own server instead (dashboard).
appeals.own: Members appeal in your own server: {invite}
appeals.ownMissing: Members appeal in your own server (the default). Add an invite on the dashboard (Enforcement), so members who were kicked or banned know where to go.

automod.label: Automod
automod.next: Turn it on on the dashboard (Automod).

verification.label: Verification
verification.next: Set it up with /verification or on the dashboard.

welcome.label: Welcome messages
welcome.next: Set them up with /welcome or on the dashboard.

tickets.label: Tickets
tickets.next: Set them up with /ticket or on the dashboard.

leveling.label: Leveling
leveling.next: Turn it on with /level or on the dashboard.

language.label: Bot language
language.default: English (default). Pick the language of posts and DMs on the dashboard (Bot language).
language.detected: {language} (your server's language in Discord). Change it on the dashboard (Bot language).

rolePosition.label: Mewvo's role position
rolePosition.ok: Above every member's top role (admins and the owner aside).
rolePosition.blocked: Members Mewvo can't moderate: {count} (top role {roles}). Drag Mewvo's role higher: Server Settings → Roles.
rolePosition.rolesAbove: Roles above Mewvo's role: {roles}. Members with them can't be moderated. Drag Mewvo's role higher: Server Settings → Roles.

commandsHint: Pick a category below to see its commands. 🔒 = Administrator only.
notYours: This menu belongs to someone else. Run /setup to get your own.

welcome.title: Thanks for adding Mewvo!
welcome.body: **Admins:** run **/setup** or open the dashboard to get started.
welcome.help: Type **/help** to see the commands. Questions? Ask in the Mewvo support server.
welcome.dm: You added Mewvo to **{server}**. Run **/setup** there or open the dashboard to get started.
welcome.ownerDm: Mewvo was added to **{server}**, but it can't post in any channel there (it needs View Channel, Send Messages and Embed Links). Run **/setup** there or open the dashboard to get started.
welcome.optional: Optional, when you want them: welcome messages, tickets, verification and leveling (level-up posts stay off until you turn them on).
